claims.rationale: The exact README assertion establishes authenticated PostgreSQL crash-data serving on GCP. Primary and positive secondary anchors identify that same literal event; the AWS source container is not asserted as the deployment. Final component licenses PostgreSQL connectivity only. SQLite fallback, vector search, RAG/fine-tuning and Resume AI identity remain unlicensed. Qualified project attribution avoids an unsupported individual-authorship claim. This is a concrete data-serving capability, not package/database setup. Unlike v7, recovery selects this explicitly PostgreSQL GCP connector; it does not transfer PostgreSQL into a Cloud-SQL-only claim from a different named project.
